about:
Omega Car & Truck Accessories, operating as Omega Customs, was founded in 2011 in Alma, Arkansas. The company serves the River Valley region of Northwest Arkansas from two locations in Alma and Fort Smith.

The shop specializes in aftermarket automotive accessories and installation services. Its offerings include computer-cut window tinting with a lifetime warranty, wheel and tire packages from major brands, lift kit installations, and a range of exterior upgrades such as grille guards, bed covers, truck toppers, and side steps. Interior upgrades cover floor mats, leather interiors, stereo and infotainment systems, LED lighting, and seat covers. The company also provides ADAS calibration services for modern vehicle safety systems. Omega Customs holds master-level MECP (Mobile Electronics Certified Professional) and ASE (Automotive Service Excellence) certifications, and is the exclusive dealer for A.R.E. and Leer truck toppers in the River Valley.

Customers include individual vehicle owners, commercial fleets, emergency service vehicles, and work trucks across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. The business supports fleet upfitting for commercial and emergency applications, offering accessories that enhance functionality and safety.

Omega Customs differentiates itself with a price-match guarantee, lifetime warranty on window tinting, certified technician installations, and online visualization tools—an Interactive Garage and Wheels Visualizer—that let customers preview modifications before purchase. Flexible financing is available through Affirm.
